title: phlomoides vulnerans
intro: Phlomoides vulnerans, commonly known as Fringed Phlomoides or Vulneraria, is a perennial herbaceous plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Phlomoides vulnerans include its ability to reduce inflammation, inhibit the growth of microorganisms, and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a valuable resource for treating infections and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Phlomoides vulnerans include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic potential.
